program: APP-SYN-01 — Bounded App-Asset / Whole-App Packet Synthesis 01

authority.approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
basis: CURRENT_STATE.md explicitly places the APP-SYN-01 versus hold sequencing decision at the active Design boundary.
PHASE_C_POST_SEL_S1_F4_REENTRY_AUDIT_06.json finds zero eligible isolated Stage variables and recommends APP-SYN-01 without auto-activating it.
DESIGN_PACKET_AND_SYNTHESIS_FRAMEWORK_01.json requires whole-system synthesis before local packets can support coherence or implementation-readiness claims.
Fresh Project truth changes no Design/Stage authority and is read-only from this gate.

objective: Test whether the current frozen Stage baseline and current bounded shared-brand/app packets form a coherent app system when viewed together; identify integration collisions, usage restraint, unresolved gaps, or evidence that earns a later targeted successor/refinement gate. This is synthesis evidence, not implementation and not another Stage candidate search.
falsification_statement: APP-SYN-01 would be unnecessary if authoritative whole-app synthesis already tested the current Stage baseline with the current packet set and CLR re-entry pressure; the recovered registry records no whole-app synthesis packet.

frozen_anchor.treatment: Immutable comparison anchor; it may be placed on a synthesis review surface but not overwritten or replaced by implication.

closed_gate_constraints: CONE-S1 F2, STATE-S1 F4 and SEL-S1 F4 failed exact Stage integration; no b-variant/reroll/retune.
PERF-S1 exact Stage comparison closed without subjective result after technical/provenance exhaustion; no same-gate Method-06 recovery.
SYM-02 and TYP-01 zero-survivor closures remain intact; VFD-01 remains closed and CTF-01 remains consumed convergence evidence.

clr_01_reentry.law: Activation selects neither family. F3/F4 are not rerun. No new CLR family or post-result retune is allowed. Any surviving contextual preference remains a Director-facing choice and is not final palette authority.

representative_synthesis_scope.principle: Build one directly human-viewable system review surface from exact/provisional packet evidence without inventing shipping screen architecture.
required_roles: EXACT_STAGE_ANCHOR — exact frozen Stage raster, unmodified and clearly labeled.
APP_NEUTRAL_COMPOSITION — reuse CMP-01 APP carrier logic rather than invent product semantics.
APP_COMPACT_IDENTITY_STACK — reuse CMP-02 APP_COMPACT identity role.
SYSTEM_INTERACTION_STRIP — show state and motion mechanisms only in source-authorized neutral semantics.
CLR_CONTEXTUAL_PROBES — contextualize only frozen CLR F2 and F1 after execution defaults are frozen.
prohibited_invention: new Studio/Archive information architecture as product authority
new Stage candidate geometry or micro-refinement
Observed Cues, pips or inter-Character arcs semantics
new creator-action, transcript/Beat/Take, provider/cost or native-window runtime semantics

evaluation_dimensions: single coherent identity hierarchy without C0/O3/type/material/state carrier competition
preservation of Character names and USER SELECTION != CURRENT OPPORTUNITY != SPEAKING != TAKE A SEAT
material topology remains structural/subordinate rather than navigation, progress, status or second-logo meaning
STA F2 remains distinct from keyboard focus and other Stage states
F1A and CS2 remain semantically disjoint with truthful CUT/reduced-motion equivalents
CLR F2 scarcity and F1 genericity pressure under accumulated packet density without color-only meaning
200% text resize/text-spacing/reflow where text hierarchy is exercised
fatigue/repetition pressure and whether removing/restraining a packet materially strengthens the whole
unresolved system gaps remain explicit rather than silently filled by fixture choices

must_freeze: exact repository source/assets and SHA-256 values for every packet contribution
exact system-review-surface topology and role placement
synthetic viewport dimensions/reflow breakpoints labeled as review fixtures, not native product minimums
neutral/base carrier tones and frozen CLR F1/F2 fixture values
motion fixture references plus CUT/reduced-motion presentation
protected Stage-master treatment, source/ablation matrix and failure thresholds
Director review entry point and diagnostic-only surfaces
mandatory_pre_materialization_freeze.law: No new synthesis image, HTML screenshot, animation capture or aesthetic scoring may be consumed before this artifact exists and passes recursive audit. Later visual evidence may not retune these frozen defaults inside this method.

review_sequence: freeze execution defaults/source manifest before visual exposure
materialize deterministic synthesis carrier from frozen sources
run structural/accessibility/mechanical preflight before subjective review
freeze Design Sol whole-system view before Director taste input
if CLR F1/F2 remain materially valid, present contextual Director choice without final-palette implication
classify only with preregistered result types and open only the smallest later gate earned by new evidence
explicit_non_authority: No automatic CLR-01 winner or final palette/typeface/motion/material/symbol/wordmark/identity.
No Phase-C exit, production tokens, shipping component system or implementation authority.
No WinUI/runtime or native accessibility validation claim.
No reopening or result-aware retuning of CIR-S1/CONE-S1/STATE-S1/PERF-S1/SEL-S1.
No replacement of PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 unless a later separately bounded successor earns promotion.
stop_conditions: a required source/master cannot be verified byte-for-byte
Product/Engineering truth materially changes the visual semantics being synthesized
the carrier would require inventing unresolved ODR/product/runtime semantics
a frozen method/default would need to change after result exposure
recursive audit finds an authority contradiction or unsupported claim
exit_condition: Close only with a frozen whole-app synthesis packet recording current compatibility/conflicts/gaps and any lawfully earned targeted successor gates; closure alone does not equal Phase-C exit or production readiness.
